annotation.interpretation_a: Senders limit bursts to at most the initial congestion window (no more than that size).
annotation.interpretation_b: Senders limit bursts to exactly the initial congestion window (the burst size must equal that size).
annotation.justification: The clause lacks a concrete constraint on the burst size relative to the initial congestion window, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the burst size should be limited to at most or exactly the initial congestion window, nor does it specify the unit (bytes or packets).
